name: list_tabs
title: List Tabs
description: List Arc tabs. Rows are flagged 'mine' for tabs this agent opened and 'isActive' for the tab the user is on. Defaults to every tab; pass scope 'own' to narrow.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against title and url

space.description: Only tabs in this space title

name: get_current_tab
title: Get Current Tab
description: Get the tab a call with no tab_id would act on: this agent's current tab, or the active tab if it has none.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

name: switch_to_tab
title: Switch To Tab
description: Make a tab the active tab in its window. Changes what the user sees, so prefer reading a tab by id when you only need its content.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs

activate.description: Also bring Arc to the front

name: close_tab
title: Close Tab
description: Close one tab. With no tab_id this closes this agent's own current tab, and is refused outright if the agent has not opened one: it will never close the tab the user is looking at. Pass an explicit tab_id from list_tabs to close any other tab. Closing cannot be undone and tab ids are not reused. To clean up after yourself, prefer close_own_tabs.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

name: close_own_tabs
title: Close Own Tabs
description: Close every tab this agent opened, leaving the user's tabs alone. Tabs leaked by a previous run of this label are left alone too unless include_stale is set.

include_stale.description: Also close tabs left behind by dead sessions of this label (see staleTabCount in arc_status). Never touches a live agent's tabs.

name: arc_status
title: Arc Status
description: Report Arc state: its version, whether it is the frontmost app, which tabs this agent owns, whether the agent space exists, what a call with no tab_id resolves to, how many tabs a previous run of this label left behind, and the guardrails (read-only mode, origin rules, audit log) this server was started with. Call it first.

name: open_url
title: Open URL
description: Open a URL in Arc. Launches Arc if needed. New tabs go into the agent space when one exists, otherwise the main window. Arc auto-selects new tabs, so the previous selection is put back unless you pass activate.

new_tab.description: Open a new tab. Set false to navigate an existing tab instead.

tab_id.description: With new_tab false, the tab to navigate. Required in that mode unless this agent already has a tab of its own, since navigating the tab the user is looking at is refused.

space.description: Space id or title to open into, overriding the agent space

little_arc.description: Open a Little Arc window. Fire and forget: Arc does not expose these afterwards.

activate.description: Bring Arc to the front and leave the new tab selected

wait_until_loaded.description: Wait for the page to finish loading before returning

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for loading. Capped at 30000ms so the call cannot outlive a client's request timeout. To wait longer, call this again.

name: go_back
title: Go Back
description: Navigate a tab back in history. Goes through the page, so it works on a background tab, which Arc's own back command does not, and the result is checked against the tab url rather than assumed.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

wait_until_loaded.description: Wait for the page to finish loading before returning

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for loading. Capped at 30000ms so the call cannot outlive a client's request timeout. To wait longer, call this again.

name: go_forward
title: Go Forward
description: Navigate a tab forward in history. Goes through the page and confirms the tab really moved before reporting success.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

wait_until_loaded.description: Wait for the page to finish loading before returning

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for loading. Capped at 30000ms so the call cannot outlive a client's request timeout. To wait longer, call this again.

name: reload_tab
title: Reload Tab
description: Reload a tab, then confirm the document really was replaced rather than assume it. Works on a background tab. Takes wait_until_loaded and timeout_ms like the other navigating tools, and returns from, to and the tab. Fails with ok false when the tab is still showing the document that was there before, which is what a slow server or a page holding on to unload looks like from outside.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

wait_until_loaded.description: Wait for the page to finish loading before returning

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for loading. Capped at 30000ms so the call cannot outlive a client's request timeout. To wait longer, call this again.

name: wait_for_load
title: Wait For Load
description: Poll until a tab has finished loading and the document is ready. Use after an action that triggers navigation.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

timeout_ms.description: Give up after this long. Capped at 30000ms so the call cannot outlive a client's request timeout. To wait longer, call this again.

url_contains.description: Also wait until the url contains this substring

name: get_page_content
title: Get Page Content
description: Get the visible text of a page, or of every element matching a selector joined with blank lines. Always reports "matched", so a partial answer is never silent. Nested matches repeat their text, so prefer a leaf-ish selector.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

first_only.description: Return only the first match instead of joining all of them

max_chars.description: Truncate the joined text at this length

name: get_html
title: Get HTML
description: Get the HTML of a page or element. Use when you need markup, attributes or structure rather than text. Returns one element only: it reports how many matched and takes nth to pick a different one.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

nth.description: Which match to return when several exist, 0-based

name: query_elements
title: Query Elements
description: Find elements and return structured details: text, value, href, visibility, disabled state and attributes. The main way to see what is on a page before acting on it. "text=" matching is substring, with exact matches ranked first; pass exact to require an exact match.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

exact.description: For a "text=" selector, match the whole text rather than a substring

verbose.description: Include the bulky element rect and longer attribute values

name: get_links
title: Get Links
description: List links on the page with their text and resolved href. Pass unique to collapse repeated href and text pairs, which navigation and footers produce in bulk.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against link text and href

unique.description: Collapse links with an identical href and text, reporting how many were dropped

name: get_page_info
title: Get Page Info
description: Page overview: title, url, ready state, meta description, headings, form and frame counts. Cheap orientation before deciding what to do.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

name: click
title: Click
description: Click an element. Accepts a CSS selector or "text=Label". Scrolls it into view and dispatches a real pointer sequence, so framework handlers fire. "text=Label" matches on visible text as a substring, with exact matches ranked first and visible elements ahead of hidden ones, so a short label also matches longer ones. Check the returned "matches" count, and pass exact when it is above 1. Returns urlBefore, the url as it was immediately before the click: the tab snapshot can be taken before a navigation settles, so follow with wait_for_load when the click navigates. A match inside a control (a label span in a button) is checked against that control, returned as "control": a disabled one fails with ok false and nothing is clicked. When another element (a modal backdrop, an overlay) covers the target, or it has pointer-events none, the click still goes through but the result carries coveredBy and a warning.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

nth.description: Which match to click when several exist, 0-based. For text= selectors the order is exact matches first, then substring matches, visible before hidden within each, then DOM order.

exact.description: For "text=" selectors, require the whole trimmed text to equal the label instead of containing it. No effect on CSS selectors.

verbose.description: Include the bulky element rect and longer attribute values

name: fill
title: Fill Field
description: Set the value of an input, textarea or contenteditable. Uses the native setter and fires input and change, so React and similar frameworks register it. Fails with an error naming the tag when the target cannot be filled: a heading or other non-input, a disabled or readonly field, a checkbox, radio or button (use click), a <select> (use select_option), or a field that rejects the value (a number input given text). "text=Label" matches on visible text as a substring, with exact matches ranked first and visible elements ahead of hidden ones, so a short label also matches longer ones. Check the returned "matches" count, and pass exact when it is above 1.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

submit.description: Press Enter, then submit the form if the page did not. Fails with ok false when nothing was submitted, or when the form fails its own validation (the invalid fields are listed). The tab usually navigates, so follow with wait_for_load: the returned tab snapshot may predate the navigation, and urlBefore reports the url from just before the key press.

exact.description: For "text=" selectors, require the whole trimmed text to equal the label instead of containing it. No effect on CSS selectors.

verbose.description: Include the bulky element rect and longer attribute values

name: select_option
title: Select Option
description: Choose an option in a select element, by exact option value or exact visible label. A disabled select or option fails rather than being set. When nothing matches, the failure lists the options that do exist, so the next call can pick a real one.

selector.description: CSS selector for the <select>. "text=" cannot reach a select element, so use a CSS selector here.

option.description: Option value or visible text, matched exactly after trimming

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

name: press_key
title: Press Key
description: Dispatch a key press to an element, or to the focused element when no selector is given. Handles named keys (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown) and single printable characters; an unknown name fails. Only the page's own key handlers react: a synthetic key types no character, moves no focus and submits no form. defaultPrevented says whether a handler took it. To type, use fill. Returns only a minimal identity for the element that received the key (tag plus whichever of id, name, type and aria-label exist); use query_elements when you need the full picture.

key.description: Key name, for example Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, or a single printable character

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

exact.description: For "text=" selectors, require the whole trimmed text to equal the label instead of containing it. No effect on CSS selectors.

name: scroll
title: Scroll
description: Scroll the page, or scroll an element into view. Page scrolls report scrollY, pageHeight and viewport, so you can tell how much is left.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

selector.description: Scroll this element into view instead of scrolling the page. CSS selector, or "text=Label" (substring, exact matches ranked first).

amount.description: Pixels to scroll for up and down

exact.description: For "text=" selectors, require the whole trimmed text to equal the label instead of containing it. No effect on CSS selectors.

verbose.description: Include the bulky element rect and longer attribute values

name: wait_for_selector
title: Wait For Selector
description: Poll until an element appears, becomes visible, or disappears. Use after a click that loads content. On timeout it says so explicitly with waitedMs and the last counts, and a broken selector or page error fails straight away instead of burning the whole timeout. The visible state ignores screen-reader clipping (boxes under 2x2 px, inset clip-path), which nothing can actually click.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

timeout_ms.description: Give up after this long. Every call returns the current counts, so repeated short waits tell you more than one long one. Capped at 30000ms so the call cannot outlive a client's request timeout. To wait longer, call this again.

exact.description: For "text=" selectors, require the whole trimmed text to equal the label instead of containing it. No effect on CSS selectors.

verbose.description: Include the bulky element rect and longer attribute values

name: list_spaces
title: List Spaces
description: List Arc spaces in the front window, with tab counts and which is active. Tabs pinned to the top of the sidebar (location topApp) belong to no space, so the reported tabsInSpaces plus topAppCount is what reconciles with totalTabs. Counts cover the front window only, while list_tabs covers every window.

name: focus_space
title: Focus Space
description: Switch the front Arc window to a space. This changes what the user sees, so it is rarely needed: tabs in an unfocused space are still fully readable and scriptable.

space.description: Space id or title from list_spaces

name: execute_javascript
title: Execute JavaScript
description: Run JavaScript in a tab and return the result. A bare expression, or a statement body that uses return, both work. The helper library is available as A (A.all, A.one, A.click, A.setValue, A.describe, A.visible).

code.description: JavaScript to evaluate. An expression returns its value; a statement body returns whatever it returns, or null.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

name: batch
title: Batch
description: Run several tools in order in one call, passing the same tab through. Stops at the first failure unless continue_on_error is set. Use this to cut round trips: fill, fill, click, wait. Results are capped at 60000 characters across all steps: past that the batch stops early and reports truncated, so pass max_chars to reading steps or split a read-heavy sequence across calls.

tool.description: Name of any other tool in this server

tab_id.description: Applied to every step that does not set its own

continue_on_error.description: Keep going after a failing step

name: wait_for_text
title: Wait For Text
description: Poll until any of several strings (or a regular expression) appears in, or disappears from, the visible text of the page or of a scope selector. Use it where wait_for_selector cannot: a status line that changes ("Saved", "Order confirmed"), or a spinner label that goes away. Reads the rendered text, so text in display:none is not seen, and text inside an iframe is not either. Same conventions as wait_for_selector: a bad regex fails straight away, and a timeout says so with waitedMs and what was found on the last poll.

texts.description: Any one of these strings counts as a match. Case-insensitive unless case_sensitive is set.

regex.description: A JavaScript regular expression source, without slashes, matched against the text. Combines with texts: either matches.

state.description: present waits for a match to appear. absent waits until none of the texts or the regex match.

selector.description: Only search the text of elements matching this selector (every match is searched). CSS selector, or "text=Label". Omit to search the whole page.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

timeout_ms.description: Give up after this long. Capped at 30000ms so the call cannot outlive a client's request timeout. To wait longer, call this again.

name: fill_form
title: Fill Form
description: Fill several fields in one call. Each field is set exactly as fill would set it, with the same checks: a disabled, readonly or non-input target fails with its reason. Fields are all attempted, in order, and every one reports its own result, so a form with one bad selector tells you which and still fills the rest. ok is false when any field failed, and error names them. Values are not echoed back. Does not submit: click the submit button afterwards.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

exact.description: For "text=" selectors, require the whole trimmed text to equal the label instead of containing it. No effect on CSS selectors.

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

name: hover
title: Hover
description: Move a pointer onto an element: pointerover, pointerenter, mouseover, mouseenter, pointermove and mousemove at its center, after scrolling it into view. Opens menus and tooltips that listen for those events. CSS :hover styling is browser state a script cannot set, so a menu driven only by :hover will not open. Like click, it reports coveredBy when another element sits on top of the target at its center.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

exact.description: For "text=" selectors, require the whole trimmed text to equal the label instead of containing it. No effect on CSS selectors.

verbose.description: Include the bulky element rect and longer attribute values

name: type
title: Type
description: Type text into an input, textarea or contenteditable one character at a time: keydown, keypress, beforeinput, a native-setter append, input and keyup for each character, appended at the end. Use it for autocomplete and search-as-you-type widgets, which react to per-character events that fill never sends. Afterwards it checks the field: ok is false when characters were not inserted (the page cancelled a key, or maxlength was reached), and the final value is reported (its length only for a password field). Events are synthetic, so a widget that checks event.isTrusted still will not react. Number, date and other non-text inputs are refused: use fill. Newlines and tabs are refused: use press_key.

selector.description: CSS selector, or "text=Some label" to match on visible text (case-insensitive substring, exact matches ranked first)

text.description: Text to type, up to 2000 characters

tab_id.description: Arc tab id from list_tabs. Omit to use this agent's current tab. A tool that changes a tab will not fall back to the tab the user is looking at, so pass this or call open_url first.

clear.description: Empty the field first. Otherwise the text is appended to what is there.

delay_ms.description: Pause between characters, up to 250ms, for widgets that debounce. Runs on page timers, which a background tab throttles to about one per second, so use 0 there or switch_to_tab first. The whole text must fit in 25000ms.

exact.description: For "text=" selectors, require the whole trimmed text to equal the label instead of containing it. No effect on CSS selectors.
